administratively_invalid_launches.concept_1/v_1: Participant TASK.md was misplaced outside the allowlist; process was stopped and this run is excluded from hardness evidence.

counterexample_replication: Two independent same-model fresh attempts are used for the witness/falsification concept; neither sees the other attempt.
fresh_access: Only read-only participant/ plus a previously empty writable attempts/v_N/; model runtime is provided by run_allowlisted_codex.sh.
artifact_freezing: After termination, snapshot the submission without following symlinks; score the private frozen snapshot to exclude late tool writes.
scoring_access: Submitted programs run under independent Landlock+seccomp restrictions. Hidden labels and scoring code remain in the parent process. Static witnesses are parsed with strict size/shape/finite checks.
baseline_improvement: The target and baseline anchor must be fixed before competitive launch, and evaluator validity is audited independently of candidate quality.
prediction_substantial_failure: Missing/invalid output, or at least 20 percent excess over a fixed core, worst-family, or tail error limit, counts as substantial. A merely marginal failure alone does not justify retaining a hard prediction concept.
final_solver_substantial_failure: Frozen before concept_1/v_5: core acceptance at most 0.80 or worst-family acceptance at most 0.50 is a substantial quality/resource miss of the unchanged 0.90/0.75 target. A core-only 0.85 result with every family at least 0.75 is marginal and does not alone justify hard retention. Missing or unrunnable submissions require a diagnostic distinction between substantive implementation failure and administrative/packaging failure.
achievement_standard: Hidden-label replay is evaluator sanity only, never predictive achievability. A claimed passing computational solution must satisfy the same scored resource and quality contract.
ratchet: For every solved concept, archive its best fresh submission, search a broad scientifically valid challenge space, cluster genuine failures, and launch a fresh challenger on an immutable new generation. Never change a generation's target using its challenger's performance.
infrastructure_smoke_tests: Noncompetitive five-minute smoke probes confirm the requested model starts, numpy/scipy imports work, and private canary reads are denied. Both smoke processes reached successful probes but hit their short ceiling while recording output; they are not hardness evidence.
